title: Ask for a trip and complete it
summary: A requester asks for a trip, the controller approves it and sends a driver, and the driver starts and completes it.
processing: The trip appears on the controller's list as waiting for approval.
evaluation: The controller checks the request and the nearest free driver.
deadlines: No fixed time limit is built; the average time to approve is on the Reports screen.
documents: None generated. History is shown on the trip.
records: Status history on the trip: who did what and when.
closure: The driver marks the trip complete.

exceptions.then: The requester sees Rejected and the reason (see S-02).

exceptions.when: The requester no longer needs it
exceptions.then: Cancel trip, allowed until the trip is on the way.

steps.action: Choose the places, the vehicle and passengers, then click Send request
steps.label: Send request

steps.action: Open the trip and click Approve trip
steps.label: Approve trip
steps.expect: The trip shows 'Approved, needs a driver'

steps.action: Choose the nearest free driver and click Assign a driver
steps.label: Assign a driver

steps.action: Open the trip and click Start the trip
steps.label: Start the trip
